annotations.title: Get current US savings account rates

description: Current US savings account APYs: FDIC national average plus rates RateZip observed daily on institutions' own published rate pages, each with observation timestamp, source URL, and staleness status. Optional balance resolves applicable balance-tier APYs and ranks by earnings; state adds an availability/eligibility note; credit_score returns a clarifying note only (deposit APYs do not vary by credit). Use for a quick current savings rate table; use compare_deposit_options when filtering by monthly-fee/direct-deposit/state requirements, calculate_deposit_earnings_difference for dollar yield gaps, or get_rate_watch_report for historical movement and alerts. Factual rate data only; does not endorse providers, offer financial advice, open accounts, or submit applications. Pass max_results to cap the number of rows and include_provenance=false for a shorter response.

balance.description: Deposit balance in USD — resolves the applicable tier APY and ranks by what you'd earn

credit_score.description: FICO — deposit APYs generally don't vary by credit; returns a clarifying note only

include_provenance.description: false omits the per-source provenance block (snapshot ids, attributions); each row keeps its own observed_at and source_url.

max_results.description: Cap the number of observed rows returned, in the payload's ordering. Omit for all.

state.description: Two-letter state — adds an availability/eligibility note

name: get_savings_rates

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the normalized rate cache.

observed.description: RateZip-observed institution rate rows with APY, applicable_apy, conditions, observed_at, source_url, and staleness.

reference.description: FDIC national average reference rate(s) via FRED.
